name: Academic Internship
description: Individual placements for field learning. Must be integrated with an academic discipline. A written contract involving all parties will include learning objectives, a paper/project outline, and means of supervision and progress evaluation. May be taken for credit up to three times. P/NP grades only.
raw_prereq: lower-division standing, completion of thirty units of UC San Diego undergraduate study, a minimum UC San Diego GPA of 3.0, and a completed and approved Learning Agreement for Special Studies.

name: Academic Internship Program
description: Individual internship placements integrated with an academic discipline. A written contract involving all parties will include learning objectives, a paper/project outline, and means of supervision and progress evaluation. Consent of faculty adviser and program chair required. May be taken for credit up to three times for a maximum of sixteen units. P/NP grades only.

name: UCDC: Washington, DC Internship
description: This internship is attached to the University of California, Washington Center programs. Students participating in the campus UCDC program secure internships in the Washington, DC area requiring 18–30 hours per week. Students must be enrolled in the UCDC program.

name: Public Service Internship
description: Individual placements for field learning performed in nonprofit organizations or government agencies dedicated to providing services in the areas of education, government, social issues, and health. May be taken for credit up to three times for a maximum of twelve units. Contract completed prior to start of internship will include intellectually unified expectations and means of supervision. Faculty member and student will meet regularly. P/NP grades only.
raw_prereq: ninety units completed; 2.5 minimum cumulative GPA; department approval.

name: Academic Internship Program—Special Programs
description: Individual placements for field learning associated with UC San Diego partnerships and special programs. A written contract involving all parties will include learning objectives, a paper/project outline, and means of supervision and progress evaluation. Consent of faculty adviser and program chair required. P/NP grades only.
raw_prereq: ninety units minimum completed; 2.5 minimum cumulative GPA; department approval.

name: Internship Seminar
description: Seminar course accompanying approved internships in professional settings. Facilitated online discussion and critical reflection on topics emphasizing professional development, practice of career readiness competencies, and applied learning. May be taken for credit up to two times. P/NP grades only.
raw_prereq: upper-division standing; department approval. Internships must be approved prior to enrollment.
